heading: Definitions.
text: NRS 158.010 Definitions. As used in this title, unless the context otherwise requires, the words and terms defined in NRS 158.100 and 158.200 have the meanings ascribed to them in those sections. (Added to NRS by 2015, 3538 )

heading: “Domestic partners” defined.
text: NRS 158.100 “Domestic partners” defined. “Domestic partners” has the meaning ascribed to it in NRS 122A.030 . (Added to NRS by 2015, 3538 )

heading: “Spouse” defined.
text: NRS 158.200 “Spouse” defined. “Spouse” includes a domestic partner as set forth in NRS 122A.200 . (Added to NRS by 2015, 3538 )
